latin: Dictum Apostoli dicentis Deus uult omnes homines saluos fieri positiue de uoluntate beneplaciti antecedente intelligenda est.
translation: The Apostle's statement that God wills all men to be saved is to be taken, in its positive sense, only of God's antecedent will of good pleasure.
